opens_with: 'Apply for <title>' -> a chooser: 'Apply without an Account' / 'Sign In' (plus a cookie banner: Accept / Reject / Cookie Settings)

fields.blocking_dialog: an 'SMS Consent' dialog (Radix) opens over the form on arrival, preset to 'I do not consent', with a Save button; it takes every click until answered -- a consent the owner gives, never the agent
fields.components: Ant Design: text inputs .ant-input, selects .ant-select (input role=combobox type=search aria-autocomplete=list), uploads .ant-upload (hidden input type=file), number .ant-input-number (G.P.A.)

choice.widget: Ant select: input role=combobox inside .ant-select; options in a portal .ant-select-dropdown, virtualised (.rc-virtual-list-holder: only the rows in view exist)
choice.pick: see interaction.resolve_ant_dropdown(): open with mousedown on the selector, read the list WHOLE by scrolling it, click the exact row, confirm the select shows it

fields.email: Email Address and Confirm Email Address (the same twice)
fields.name: Prefix (select), First, Middle, Last, Suffix (select)
fields.phone: two phones (Home, Mobile), each with its own 'Country dialing code' select
fields.address: Country (select) -> State/Province (select, depends on the country) -> Address Line 1-3, City (text), County (text), Zip / Postal Code
fields.education: repeated entries ('Add Education History'): Degree (text), Not Completed (checkbox), Major, Minor, School (text, free), Country and State/Province (selects, dependent), City, G.P.A. (number)
fields.file: hidden ant-upload inputs: 'Import Resume' (parses the resume into the form), 'Add Cover Letter', 'Add Additional Documents'
fields.source: 'How did you hear about this job?' (select, required)
fields.language: a 'Language' select at the top of the form (the form's own language, not a question about the candidate)
